listing.name: Folklore — Folklore native PC recompilation (Mava-b) (Mava-b)
listing.summary: The author reports gameplay and motion captures on one Windows 11 PC with a Ryzen 7800X3D. Higher frame rates are experimental; other hardware and complete gameplay remain unconfirmed. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own North American BCUS98147 disc version 1.00, in JB folder form with decrypted EBOOT.elf of 6518936 bytes. European and Japanese editions and update 1.10 are rejected.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow setup.ps1, build.ps1 and run.ps1 to download tools and generate C++ locally. Setup may install Visual Studio Build Tools machine-wide; review those changes before running it. Keep your original disc folder available while playing.

warnings: The author reports gameplay and motion captures on one Windows 11 PC with a Ryzen 7800X3D. Higher frame rates are experimental; other hardware and complete gameplay remain unconfirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
